verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a skill collection could plausibly ship a skill-authoring meta-skill. None of the documented skills is one: they cover spec writing, ticket splitting, TDD, review, research, refactoring reports, debugging, merge conflicts, handoff, triage, grilling and repo setup. The closest item (docs-23) only helps you pick which existing skill to use; it does not help write, improve, or package new skills.
